properties.description: The landing batch as an opaque Binary dataset, on purpose. The landing->bronze copy does NOT parse the JSON — it moves the gzipped bytes verbatim so bronze is a faithful, replayable copy of exactly what the source sent. Parsing happens in the Databricks silver step where a rescue column can catch what the schema misses. A DelimitedText/Json dataset here would force ADF to interpret the file and would drop a malformed line on the floor before bronze ever saw it, defeating the point of a raw landing zone.
